_comment: Every test family Agent-12 logs. The big benchmarks already have coverage everywhere; the point of this file is that the small ones get logged too, with the same shape, so they can be compared instead of argued about.

suites.title: Agent tasks, easy
suites.measures: Twelve filesystem-judged coding tasks. Does the model actually edit files, not describe editing them.

suites.title: Agent tasks, hard
suites.measures: The same harness on tasks that need multi-file reasoning and exact output.

suites.title: Will it fit a Mac
suites.measures: Unified memory a model needs, from its own file list and config. Not a speed test.

suites.title: Vision: describe a photo
suites.measures: One fixed set of photos, one fixed prompt. Is the description right, and does it name what matters rather than everything.

suites.title: Vision: read the text in the picture
suites.measures: Signs, labels, handwriting, a screenshot. Exact-string scored, so there is nothing to argue about.

suites.title: Vision: find the object
suites.measures: Detection models on a fixed image set, scored on boxes, the test that matters for a camera that has to act.

suites.title: Speech to text
suites.measures: Word error rate on the same clips, including noisy and accented ones, which is where the published numbers stop being true.

suites.title: Long context, actually retrieved
suites.measures: A fact buried at a known depth. Does the model find it at 8k, 32k, 128k, and what does the memory do while it tries.

suites.title: Tool calls that parse
suites.measures: How often a model emits a tool call the runtime can actually execute, which is the failure that kills local agents.
